text.en:
Currency Act
(CHAPTER 69)
Currency
(Denominations and Characteristics of Coins)
Notification 2021
Pursuant to section 17(5) of the Currency Act, it is notified for general information that the denominations and characteristics of the coins to be issued on 12 November 2021 by the Monetary Authority of Singapore are as shown in the Schedule.

THE SCHEDULE

Design of Obverse
1.The background of the $2 nickel‑plated zinc proof‑like coin and the $5 silver proof colour coin is shiny silver.
2.The Singapore Coat of Arms is engraved in the centre of the coin with the year‑date “2021” below it.
3.The word “SINGAPORE” appears once in each of the 4 official languages and is engraved on the coin around the Singapore Coat of Arms.
4.The mintmark is engraved on the coin around the Singapore Coat of Arms at 5 o’clock for the $5 silver proof colour coin.
Design of Reverse
1.The background of the $2 nickel‑plated zinc proof‑like coin and the $5 silver proof colour coin is shiny silver.
2.The words “HAWKER CULTURE IN SINGAPORE” are engraved on the upper circumference with the words “UNESCO INTANGIBLE CULTURAL HERITAGE OF HUMANITY” engraved on the lower circumference of the coin.
3.The $2 nickel-plated zinc proof‑like coin and the $5 silver proof colour coin share a common design which features —
(a)in the foreground — 3 male hawkers and one female hawker from diverse cultural backgrounds preparing the following local favourites (in clockwise direction from the top‑left hawker):
(i)Hokkien Mee (fried prawn noodles);
(ii)Nasi Lemak (fragrant rice cooked in coconut milk, served with fried chicken, egg, anchovies, peanuts, cucumber and sambal);
(iii)Kaya Toast accompanied with soft‑boiled eggs and Kopi (coffee); and
(iv)Roti Prata (Indian flatbread served with curry) and Indian Rojak; and
(b)in the background and all in engraving —
(i)patrons, young and old, enjoying their meals in a hawker centre setting, are depicted in the left and centre;
(ii)a chicken rice stall is depicted on the right; and
(iii)a tray return rack is depicted to the left of the chicken rice stall.
4.The $2 nickel-plated zinc proof‑like coin also features —
(a)its foreground minted in relief engraving; and
(b)the denomination “$2” engraved and placed at 6 o’clock, between the male and female hawkers.
5.The $5 silver proof colour coin also features —
(a)its foreground in colour; and
(b)the denomination “$5” engraved and placed at 6 o’clock, between the male and female hawkers.
